purpose: Teach: 證/噺/英和/云わ/ノベル/広東/にたいする/事物

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、旧字「證」、つまり證券業界の動向を社内で共有しろ
lines.en: Share the securities industry trends with the team.
lines.style: Clipped, declarative. Lean forward slightly on the verb. Expectant pause—you're giving an instruction, not asking. Measured authority without harshness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員向け落語の噺の会を企画します
lines.en: Yes. I'll plan a storytelling event for the staff—traditional rakugo performances.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation. Slight pause after the affirmative, as if mentally noting the task. Steady, methodical delivery. Flat affect—showing he's already thinking through logistics.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、英和翻訳の品質を上げろ
lines.en: Improve the quality of our English-Japanese translations.
lines.style: Direct, measured. Tap of emphasis on 'improve.' Same assured tone—this is non-negotiable. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の云わ、つまり「云った」社訓を再共有します
lines.en: Yes. I'll refresh everyone on the founder's principles—our company motto.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Quiet respect when mentioning the founder's legacy. No rush. Matter-of-fact about the task ahead, as if this is exactly right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、企業ノベル、つまり経営小説からも学べ
lines.en: We should also learn from business novels—they offer practical insights.
lines.style: Conversational but authoritative. Slight lean into 'also'—this is an addition to the broader strategy. Thoughtful pace. The suggestion of someone who reads.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広東省の取引先との連携を強化します
lines.en: Yes. I'll strengthen our partnerships with clients in Guangdong.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation. Specific regional detail delivered with the confidence of someone who knows the territory. Methodical, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場変動にたいする対応力を高めろ
lines.en: Strengthen our ability to respond to market shifts.
lines.style: Sharp, final-sounding. Emphasis on 'respond'—agility matters. Slightly louder than the previous directives. The weight of a CEO setting strategic priorities.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事物、つまり製品の品質管理を徹底します
lines.en: Yes. I'll tighten quality control across our product line—thoroughness in every step.
lines.style: Firm, conclusive. Slow deliberate delivery on 'tighten' and 'thoroughness.' This is the capstone response. Quiet confidence that the work will be done.
